body_lead: AI Technology Helps Tamil Nadu Police Trace Fugitive Wanted In 2007 Murder Police claimed using AI technology to predict the current appearance of fugitive Sheikh Abdullah, arresting him after 19 years on the run for murder. Chennai: Tamil Nadu Police have arrested a murder suspect who had been absconding for the last 19 years. Officials claimed that artificial intelligence (AI) technology helped them trace the alleged criminal. The fugitive, named Sheikh Abdullah, was accused in the 2007 murder of Pandiamani in Tiruvottiyur.
